svg.text: OpenClaw on Firecracker · Multi-Tenant AI Agent Platform — AWS Delivery Architecture
End-user and admin entry paths are separate · user chat via CloudFront→ALB→WebSocket cluster · serverless control plane orchestrates the full tenant lifecycle

text.region: · single VPC · east-west via host iptables

svg.text: In-app end user of the platform
Can be internal, no public CloudFront
Data plane · customer-facing chat traffic (one dedicated-kernel microVM per tenant)
Same hardening: read-only EROFS golden image + per-VM writable overlay + cap-drop / seccomp, tenant A / B identical
Browser wss direct · tenant channel subscribes same cluster
Route by tenant + fan-out; connection stamps verified sub, tenant-isolated
EC2 Auto Scaling Group · openclaw-hosts-asg · auto-scaling by load
Host r8g.metal-24xl (Graviton4 · 96 vCPU / 768GB) · bare-metal native KVM (single-layer virtualization)
Change identity = bake new image, no hot-push
Tenant channel subscribes WS cluster (one-way VM→hub)
Stop to save resources · keep disk
per-tenant vkey billing / quota · model routing
Egress inspection (any egress cut off layer by layer): from host to VPC boundary
Control plane · fully-managed serverless · orchestrates full tenant lifecycle (no servers to operate)
Real call chain (left to right, end to end): admin POST /tenants → JWT+RBAC → DDB CAS atomic alloc → SSM dispatch → host boots VM
Side services (scheduled and supporting, not on main path):
Orchestration: SSM pushes control-plane decisions to hosts
Start/stop/rebuild VM · roll image · update ALB rule (host executes, no hot-change to VM)
AWS-native security boundary · defense in depth L1–L5
Spans data and control planes · edge to kernel, layer by layer
· WAF: rate limit / SQLi / IP reputation
· DNS FW + NAT egress allowlist (Network Firewall TLS_SNI planned)
· Read-only EROFS identity disk + per-VM overlay
Monitoring visibility layers · probe placement (host probe cannot see into guest)
① Inspector (host CVE, account-level, not deployed by this stack)
② GuardDuty account-level threat detection (Runtime Monitoring off by default)
· Full control-plane API audit (create/delete tenant/schedule/ALB rule) → S3
· Control-plane API audit → S3 + DynamoDB audit table
